actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: The repository contains the simulated environment and training code for DexPoint
The environment is constructed in-process from its Python class with keyword arguments, with no transport setup
AllegroRelocateRLEnv is the concrete environment; LabRelocateEnv and BaseRLEnv are its parents
The constructor defaults the robot to allegro_hand_xarm6_wrist_mounted_face_front, the object category to YCB and the object to tomato_soup_can
The default robot's configuration declares hand_dof 16 and arm_dof 6
The action space is Box(low=-1, high=1) with shape (action_dim,)
action_dim returns the robot's degree-of-freedom count
The oracle state concatenates robot qpos (dof), palm position (3), object pose (7), object-to-tip offsets (12), contact flags (5), target offset (3), target quaternion (4) and target angle (1)
For a state-only environment obs_dim is the length of the oracle state
The observation space is a Box from -infinity to +infinity with obs_dim elements
The SAPIEN scene timestep is 0.005 s
One control step advances frame_skip simulation steps: control_time_step is the scene timestep times frame_skip
The horizon is 200 control steps
OBJECT_LIFT_LOWER_LIMIT is -0.03
An episode is done when object_lift is below OBJECT_LIFT_LOWER_LIMIT
step applies the action, updates the cached state and returns (observation, reward, done, info); at the horizon it sets done and info['TimeLimit.truncated']
reset re-seeds when a seed is given, resets the internal state and returns the new observation
The object start pose is drawn uniformly in x and y from (-0.1, 0.1) times randomness_scale at the object height
The target pose is drawn uniformly in x and y from (-0.2, 0.2) times randomness_scale at height 0.25
seed installs the random generator and returns [seed]
The reward gives 0.5 on contact, 10 times the lift clipped to 0..0.2, a 1.0 bonus above 0.02 lift plus 1/(0.04 + target distance), and divides the total by 10
The thumb's finger reward scale is 0.04 and the other three tips use 0.01
The package requires numpy, transforms3d, gym 0.25.2, sapien 2.1.0, open3d, imageio and torch, and declares Python 3.8 or newer
The installation instructions download day.ktx and place it at assets/misc/ktx/day.ktx

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the object and target draw, and the stand-in is deterministic after that; the fake draws with Python's random module while upstream draws with numpy's generator, so one seed gives different poses on the two

gaps: no dynamics: the stand-in advances a step counter and integrates the first three action values into a palm position; it models no rigid-body motion, contact, friction, actuator or sensor, and the object and target stay at their reset poses

the observation has the upstream layout but its fingertip offsets, contact flags, object height and quaternion are fixed placeholders that no collision engine computes, and only the first three action values move the palm; the hand values are recorded as qpos
the initial object and target poses use Python's random module, upstream uses numpy's generator, so a seed gives different poses on the two
timestep_ms 50.0 is the upstream control step (0.005 s scene timestep x the constructor default frame_skip 10 at dexpoint/env/rl_env/relocate_env.py:17); the stand-in only counts steps
the stand-in was never compared with a SAPIEN run: sapien 2.1.0 is not installed where the gate runs and the clone does not carry the day.ktx or ShapeNet/EGAD assets its README downloads
no rendering, visual observation, imagination buffers or passive environment checker is modelled
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation and state stay readable
